messages:
From: Tom Redding <tom@acme-corp.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: SOC 2 renewal — logs & SLA questions

Hi Karthik,

We're kicking off our SaaS renewals for Q4 and want to align on the SOC 2 re-attestation scope and evidence transfer for ACME's renewal (renewal date 2026-11-15). A couple of specific asks from our security and procurement teams: 

- Retention: we need a formal option to extend production audit logs to 365 days (currently 90). Can Redwood provide a signed amendment outlining retention windows and associated price deltas?
- Evidence package: for the re-attestation, our auditors prefer a single evidence bundle containing system diagrams, control narratives, and raw audit logs for a representative 30-day window. Preferred format for logs is parquet or gzipped JSON export.
- Export delivery: can you provide S3 pre-signed URLs (or an SFTP endpoint) for bulk transfer? We will need checksums and a manifest.
- SLA: confirm whether the log export and evidence handoff are covered under the existing SLA or if the extended retention triggers a different support / delivery SLA.
- Capacity: we're also evaluating a +2 dedicated capacity uplift (we currently have 4 reserved GPUs) to support a pilot in EMEA. Any lead times or contract implications?

I've attached our internal evidence requirements PDF to this message. Can you outline a proposed timeline and who on your side will own the evidence handoff and contract amendment?

Thanks,
Tom

Tom —

Thanks for the clear list. We can support the items you outlined; below is a concrete proposal so you can share with procurement/audit: 

1) Retention options and amendment
- Options: 90 days (default), 180 days (add-on), 365 days (add-on).
- Delivery: we'll prepare a brief contract amendment (term + pricing appendix) that lists the chosen retention window and any data egress/storage uplift. Expect a redline-ready draft within 3 business days.

2) Evidence package and exports
- We will assemble an evidence bundle containing: SOC 2 attestation letter (if in scope), system architecture diagram, control narratives, relevant runbooks, and a 30-day raw-audit-log export in parquet (preferred) or gzipped JSON if you require.
- Delivery mechanism: S3 pre-signed URLs + manifest file (CSV) with checksums (sha256). We can also support SFTP on request but S3 is faster for large exports.

3) SLA and delivery times
- Evidence handoffs and exports are handled through our Professional Services/Support workflow; standard delivery windows are 7–10 business days for a packaged evidence bundle.
- Extended retention itself does not change the availability SLA (we keep the same uptime SLA), but contract language will call out delivery SLAs for evidence exports (we'll propose a 10-business-day window post-request for agreed exports under the renewal process).

4) Capacity uplift
- +2 dedicated units (from 4 -> 6): typical lead time for Dedicated GPU reservation is 14–21 days depending on region. For EMEA pilot we may need an additional 3–5 days for regional provisioning. Pricing uplift will be included in the amendment.

Next steps I propose (if that works for you):
- I'll circulate an evidence playbook and an export manifest template (attached).
- Legal will draft the retention/term amendment and pricing appendix within 3 business days.
- If you confirm preferred retention (180 vs 365) and desired capacity (+2), I'll assign owners internally and share a mutual action plan with milestones.

Owners on our side: Marissa Cole (Evidence assembly), Kimberly Park (Export + S3 links), Lauren Bishop (Legal amendment), Ben Carter (pricing & upsell path).

Let me know if you want to set a short call tomorrow to align on the mutual action plan.

Best,
Karthik
